text: 创业板指跌超2%，沪指跌0.4%，深成指跌1.7%，农业、贵金属、油气、煤炭等方向跌幅居前，沪深京三市下跌个股近4200只
text_en: ChiNext Index falls over 2%, Shanghai Composite down 0.4%, Shenzhen Component down 1.7%; agriculture, precious metals, oil and gas, coal among biggest decliners; nearly 4,200 stocks fall across Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing markets
